gloss: to protest; to object; to lodge a complaint

definitions.gloss: to protest; to object; to lodge a complaint
definitions.explanation: To formally express opposition or dissatisfaction with a decision, action, or situation. Used for both public demonstrations and formal objections.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗議|こうぎ}した。
⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗議|こうぎ}する⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many players protested the referee's call.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}→環境破壊：15957_kankyouhakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗議|こうぎ}する⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}→世界各地：24526_sekaikakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Demonstrations protesting environmental destruction were held around the world.

notes:
Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the target of protest: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗議|こうぎ}する (to protest against X). Can refer to both organized public protests and individual formal objections. The noun ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧ is also extremely common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧: protest demonstration
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: protest activities
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧: letter of protest
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦{集会|しゅうかい}→集会：14654_shuukai⟧: protest rally
- ⟦{厳重|げんじゅう}→厳重：11887_genjuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗議|こうぎ}する: to lodge a strong protest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to oppose — broader term for disagreement; does not imply taking action
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}を{唱|とな}える→異議を唱える：19072_igiwotonaeru⟧: to raise an objection — more formal; used in legal and parliamentary contexts
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to complain — less formal; expresses personal dissatisfaction without the confrontational tone of ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧
